nav.title: Sikhungo Sekhulumisana se-AI
nav.subtitle: Lusito lwe tilwimi letinyenti kanye nekudluliselwa lokulawulwa kumuntfu.

customer.title: Cala inkhulumo
customer.consentText: Ngiyavuma kutsi le nkhulumo ingacutjungulwa ngemhlinzeki we-AI. Imibhalo icindzetelwa ngaphambi kwekugcinwa.
customer.setupHint: Akukhonakali kuze umphatsi ahlele sikhihi nemhlinzeki we-AI.
customer.chatEmpty: Imilayeto ibonakala lapha. Tento te-AI ticucesha kuphela; akukho kukhokha noma kushintja kwe-akhawunti.
customer.voiceStreamNote: Livezi lesiphequluli lithunyelwa kumhlinzeki; i-OpsCore ayitsi igcina livezi lomphendvulo.
customer.voiceRequirement: Livezi lesiphequluli lidzinga i-HTTPS, imakrofoni, imvume, imodeli ye-Realtime nesikhihi. Akusilo lucingo.

queue.title: Umugca wekudlulisela
queue.description: Inkhulumo leyingoti noma lecelile umuntfu ibonakala lapha. Umugca wukucela, akusiko kuxhumana.
queue.replyStorageNote: Tiphendvulo temuntfu ticindzetelwe tese tibonakala emibhalweni.

boundaries.title: Imikhawulo yemisebenti
boundaries.automateBody: Kuphendvula kucala ngetilwimi letinyenti, kucacisa, kuhlola ingoti, kugcina imibhalo nekuhlela umugca.
boundaries.humanBody: Kucela umuntfu, kungatsembeki, ingoti lekhulu, imitsetfo lengakho, incingo lengakalungiswa, sikhala semfihlo.
boundaries.notEnabledBody: PSTN/SIP, WhatsApp, imeyili, lucingo, CRM nekucinisekisa tilwimi kudzinga umhlinzeki wangempela netivivinyo.

messages.qualificationNotice: Alikho lulwimi lolugunyatiwe kuze tivivinyo temibhalo, i-ASR, i-TTS nelivezi tiphele.
messages.configOk: Kuhlela kukhona. Kuxhumana nekhwalithi yelulwimi kudzinga tivivinyo tangempela.
messages.conversationCreated: Inkhulumo levikekile yakhiwe. Ikhwalithi yelulwimi ayikagunyatwa.
messages.handoffQueued: Kudlulisela kumuntfu kufakiwe emgceni ({reason}). Kukucela, akusiko kuxhumana.
messages.aiResponseFailed: Kuphendvula kwe-AI akukapheleli. Akukho tento lentekile. Ungacela umuntfu.
messages.apiUnavailable: I-API yekhulumisano ayitholakalanga. Ngena ku-OpsCore bese uvuselela lelikhasi.
messages.handoffQueuedQueueOnly: Kudlulisela kufakiwe emgceni ({reason}). Umugca awubonisi kutsi umsebenti ukhona.
messages.voiceHandoffStopped: Kudlulisela kufakiwe emgceni. Inkhulumo ye-AI iyema; lucingo aluhleliwe.
messages.voiceRealtimeError: Umhlinzeki we-Realtime ubonise liphutsa. Misa livezi, uhlole kuhlela, bese uphinda.
messages.voiceActive: Inkhulumo yelivezi iyasebenta. Cela umuntfu nganoma nini; lokhu kwakha umugca, akusilo lucingo.
